description: The agent must: (1) Read all 6 input JSON files in /workspace/accounts/meta/campaigns/ to extract account structure, bidding config, budget allocation, performance time series, test history, and existing alert thresholds. (2) Produce a campaign_audit_report.json with exactly 5 top-level keys matching the Output Contract: account_health_and_structure_score, bid_and_budget_efficiency_findings, ab_test_structure_blueprint, scale_model, monitoring_and_alert_rules. (3) In account health: flag naming convention violations ('summer sale', 'google retarget') and apply the decision rule that high adset complexity with low total spend ($120 across 7 adsets = $17/adset) requires simplification before adding new tests. (4) In bid/budget findings: flag that the KPI is blended_roas but all bid strategies are target_cpa (misalignment), and flag budget fragmentation below the learning threshold. (5) In ab_test_structure_blueprint: use the exact schema from SKILL.md (test_id, variable, cells with control+challenger keys, success_metric), enforce a 95% statistical significance threshold, and explicitly address the prior two underpowered tests (71% and 68% confidence) per the 'extend learning window' decision rule. (6) In monitoring_and_alert_rules: define the exact anomaly rule from SKILL.md (spend_spike_pct > 35 AND conversions_drop_pct > 25 => severity: high, action: notify_and_limit_budget), identify 2026-07-15 as the anomaly day (spend +43%, conversions -37%) even though the raw data incorrectly marks anomaly_detected=False, and tie all alert rules to action ownership. (7) In scale_model: define gate conditions/trigger thresholds before budget increases are allowed.
